tiktok.body:
TOP 5 APPS I USE EVERYDAY IN COLLEGE | #college #collegeapps #appsforcollege #collegestudent #studyapp @Goodnotes @Quizlet @Google @apple
Hi, my name is abbie. I'm a rising sophomore at penn state berks, and I'm gonna help you get through college. Number one, good notes. I literally use good notes every single day of lecture, and I even use it on the weekends when I need to study. The number one note taking app, period. Number two, Quizlet. This is my number one studying app because I can literally just plug in my notes and it will create me a study guide and flashcards. number three, notebook LM. Absolutely no one knows about notebook LM. It is literally free and it's through google. Notebook LM is my second favorite studying tool because I can literally plug in my notes and it can create me videos, podcast, presentations, practice quizzes, literally anything you can think of. The reason is my second favorite is because when I upload my notes, in order for, like, the AI in the app to generate my content, it does take longer than Quizlet. number four, the Apple Calendar app. Everyone is always like, oh, you need, like, a separate class app. Oh, you need this oh you need that. No, you don't. You literally have your apple calendar. Use it. Okay. This is literally how I have my setup. So in the morning, I have a class, and then I allotted time for lunch, room for me to study, I have another class, and then I work at Night! And at the bottom I have listed when the party starts. All my classes lectures are broken down by color. It's literally perfect. number five. Literally any of the Google programs. I'm talking Google Docs, Google Sides, and Google Sheets. I also use Google Forms for my statistic classes and I normally get so much hate because everybody's like oh, just us Microsoft microsoft is more professional. my High school didn't teach me how to use Microsoft and they told me how to use Google. This is what i know best. And if you made this far in the video, you meant to follow me because I'm gonna help you make it through college. And as always, my comments and games are always open. Wishing you guys best luck in college! Bye!
